# Javier Emmanuel Anguiano Pita

<p class="lead">Postdoctoral Researcher · SECIHTI — Universidad de Guadalajara</p>

I am an economist specializing in international economics and applied econometrics. My research examines North American economic and financial integration, exchange-rate and interest-rate dynamics, and the macroeconomic effects of environmental shocks.

[Research](research.qmd) · [Publications](publications.qmd) · [Curriculum vitae](cv.qmd) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3902-534X)
:::

## Research interests

- International economics and North American integration
- Financial connectedness and international monetary transmission
- Applied time-series and panel econometrics
- Environmental economics and regional economic activity

## Current affiliation

Postdoctoral Researcher, Universidad de Guadalajara, Centro Universitario de Ciencias Económico Administrativas, Department of Quantitative Methods / Doctorate in Economic Studies. Supported by SECIHTI.

## Selected projects

::: {.project-card}
**Financial connectedness in North America**  
Time-varying and frequency-domain spillovers among foreign exchange and financial markets. [Read more](projects/connectedness.qmd).
:::

::: {.project-card}
**Temperature shocks and economic activity in Mexico**  
Heterogeneous state-level responses using panel local projections. [Read more](projects/temperature.qmd).
:::

::: {.project-card}
**Monetary policy transmission in Mexico**  
Factor-augmented vector autoregressions and macroeconomic indicators. [Read more](projects/monetary-policy.qmd).
:::
